// diagnostic

E1012

`{from}` in Core layer `{from_layer}` names `{to}` of the higher layer `{to_layer}`

What

`{from}` in Core layer `{from_layer}` names `{to}` of the higher layer `{to_layer}`

Why

Core's `layers:` table in `Core/package.jet` orders Core's modules lowest first, and a module names only modules of its own layer or a lower one, so a program that reaches a low layer never loads a higher one

Fix

Move the code that names `{to}` up to layer `{to_layer}`, or move what it names down to layer `{from_layer}` or lower
